page0.text:
There are only two sets of shoes at the entrance.
Fuji-nee's heels and Saber's loafers.

page1.text:
...
I'm worried, so I go to the living room without announcing that I'm home.
Briskly, I make my way down the hall.
As expected, Sakura isn't in the living room.
Instead, I spy someone that looks suspiciously like Fuji-nee doing something that might be cooking in the kitchen.

page2.text:
"Oh, welcome back, Shirou. What's with that surprised face?
Did something happen?"
She puts down what appears to be flour. If I didn't know any better, she looks like she's been mixing something.

page3.text:
"Oh... Well, yeah. I am surprised.
Um, everything's so different than usual."
Actually, I don't remember how many years it's been since I last saw Fuji-nee doing something like cooking.

page4.text:
"Different than usual...? Oh, you must mean Sakura.
She went home. Someone from her home called her to come back."

page5.text:
"...I see. Shinji must've called her."
He didn't need to worry, but I guess he wanted to take care of it as soon as possible.
"Shinji? Hmm, whatever."
After tilting her head as if she's not satisfied, she goes back to what she was doing.
